title: gen_surv: Survival Data Simulation in Python
description: gen_surv generates synthetic time-to-event datasets from twelve models — proportional hazards, accelerated failure time, competing risks, cure fractions, piecewise hazards, recurrent events and two illness-death processes — so that an estimator can be tested against parameters the user chose. Alongside the data it can return the ground truth a real dataset could never contain: the coefficients actually used, latent event and censoring times, cure status and transition times. Inspired by the R package genSurv and extended well past it.
